 Singapore investing another S$135m in research for coastal protection, flood resilience 
 03:03 Min
 Singapore is investing another S$135 million in research to strengthen coastal defences and reduce flood risks. The funding will support more efficient flood management systems, sustainable construction methods and digital monitoring technologies. National water agency PUB says the move will help Singapore prepare for rising sea levels and heavier rainfall.
